description: The 6-market agentic-fund ladder (founder vision 2026-06-13). One uniform pipeline per instrument: archive 1m -> ORB-3m signal -> stage. Promotion ladder: shadow (log+score forward, no execution) -> demo (bounded experiment, real demo fills) -> live (after the bot edge clears the $3k gate). Promote an instrument by changing its stage here; the edge config is identical across all (the structurally-confirmed ORB-3m). Metric for promotion is FORWARD shadow evidence per instrument (PF>=1.5, n>=30, positive net), not just backtest.

demo_to_live.note: Founder gate: bot edge must clear $3k consistently in demo before any live.
